thermal_contract: No initial B-L/asymmetry or nonthermal sources. Standard radiation-dominated abundances and entropy, both Majoranas start no more abundant than their relativistic equilibrium yields. Out-of-equilibrium decay source counted once per relativistic yield, absolute flavor efficiencies <=1. SM sphaleron conversion at freezeout. Zero-temperature nonresonant one-loop decay kernels. No additional source or spectator enhancement beyond the stated response budget.
